lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca4Zn8As4S12 (reduced formula CaZn2AsS3) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for As, S, and Zn centers, with As and S each surrounded by four Zn neighbors and Zn showing mixed As/S coordination. These tetrahedra connect through corner- and edge-sharing relations, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network. Ca centers exhibit 8-vertex coordination with mixed As, S, and Zn neighbors, though this environment does not have a recognized geometric motif label.
